notes.title: September Developer Letter
notes.notes: [p]Hello, conductors of Frostrain from all around the world! It’s already September. Here where our dev team is located, the cool autumn breeze has begun to blow. How is it in your country? Wherever you are, the time to prepare for winter has surely come. That’s right—winter, the season of Frostrain, is upon us again! (Of course, we know some of you enjoy warm winters too. But since the first game launched in winter, we’ll go ahead and call it Frostrain’s season 😄)[/p][p]Let us share what we’ve been working on. Frostrain2 will be participating in the October Steam Next Fest, which means you’ll soon be able to play the demo. We would love to hear your feedback! As we are a very, very small team of just three people, your input is invaluable. In truth, Frostrain2 is a project we are creating together with you. We look forward to your continued support![/p][p][/p][h1]The Young Revolutionary, Joe Mimi[/h1][hr][/hr][p]Do you remember Joe Mimi? She burst onto the scene at a young age and seized control of the train. But she was given a challenge—she had to prove her worth to passengers who doubted her. What happened that led her to become a conductor? And what lies ahead for her?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/92d2b4a9ec9cd86ac8ff3ad1838dd6dd628c8b5f.png"][/img][/p][p]Oh, and earlier I mentioned you’d be able to enjoy the demo during the Steam Next Fest in October, right? Here’s a small hint: the story begins with Conductor Choi Soon-ja. From Choi Soon-ja to Im Seok-dae to Joe Mimi, you’ll be able to follow the conductors’ stories one after another. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h1]Artifact Drone Supply[/h1][hr][/hr][p]I love artifacts. Trains are wonderful, but artifacts have a charm all their own. They make possible the things that a train alone cannot. That’s why artifacts are special—because they deserve to be treated with care.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/d98db67ab06ec2221f5f10518c1b68e9e9e3d0ef.gif"][/img][/p][p]So… we made this! It may not be as essential as the train, but it’s just as special. You’ll even get to see the infamous “Sadism” artifact we revealed earlier. Doesn’t it just radiate uniqueness?[/p][p][/p][h1]Clearer Tooltips[/h1][hr][/hr][p]We love clear tooltips! Take a look at this screenshot:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/2003801c2450e7818204050e27ec1b34375b2af9.png"][/img][/p][p]Ah, this is from one of the Decisions we introduced in the last Developer Letter! Executing this Decision causes you to lose Backlash. But… what is “Backlash”? (Am I the only one suddenly reminded of the “What is zeal?” meme?)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/65bf77883cbd1b504aacdda6fc00735b77dbbbed.png"][/img][/p][p]When you hover over an underlined keyword like this, you’ll get a clear explanation of what it means. By knowing exactly what you gain and what you give up, you’ll be able to plan your train operations with greater clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/112d6ef58d91a8504e497d11ea3c0231ca5edc7a.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s not all! When you hover over a train, you can also see in detail what paths contributed to its Happiness gain.[/p][p][/p][h1]Richer Exploration[/h1][hr][/hr][p]One of the weaknesses of the first game was that the environmental elements were limited, which made exploration feel a bit lacking. This time, we’ve added new features to address that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/84ab65b267070ef2998e040530fae234ce15e0b4.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s Frostrain2’s world map—this is the first time we’ve shown it publicly! As you can see, visibility is restricted. There are several reasons, but one of the biggest is the mountain ranges. From the valley, you can’t see what’s beyond. But once you climb up…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/d721b79419e3a10d62e1b6705cca13dd4d46f5da.gif"][/img][/p][p]The view expands dramatically, revealing a much wider world! At times you may feel frustrated when the mountains block your sight, but that only makes the satisfaction of unveiling the landscape from above all the greater. Suddenly, I just want to climb every mountain I see.[/p][p][/p][h1]More Diverse Events[/h1][hr][/hr][p]The more events, the better![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/c4a391349ee102f7fada89e3c584294995f8dfb1.png"][/img][/p][p]In the demo, the number will be limited, but in the full release we plan to include a wide variety of events with different rewards. Of course, not all events will be pleasant. Sometimes you’ll have to put up with inconveniences, and sometimes you’ll have to leave things to chance. That’s life, after all.[/p][p]And also…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/05eb6b9754d317ef08ffc63cecf9c5b27ee5fc93.png"][/img][/p][p]You might just find yourself with an adorable cat! Haha.[/p][p][/p][h1]In Closing[/h1][hr][/hr][p]We’re truly excited that the day is near when we can finally show you the demo. At the same time, we feel the weight of responsibility. Once the demo is released, we’ll make another announcement. It’s really not long now! We look forward to your feedback—thank you![/p][p][/p][p]With gratitude,[/p][p]nemoman[/p]

notes.title: August Developer Letter
notes.notes: [p]Hello to all the conductors of Frostrain who continue to enjoy our journey![/p][p]It’s that time again — one month has already passed since our last letter. Over the past weeks, we’ve been hard at work building, polishing, and preparing the demo release. Shall we take a look at what we’ve been working on?[/p][p][/p][h1]The Academy’s Conductor: Choi Soon-ja[/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/18baf4db4b2ec19297408c312b1df918fbd4dc29.png"][/img][/p][p]The stern and intellectual conductor, [b]Choi Soon-ja[/b], has returned![/p][p]In the first game, she inspired many players with her powerful performance. And in this new entry, her abilities remain as formidable as ever![/p][p]But with great power comes many restrictions, and these will weigh heavily on her this time. Why did she wander so tirelessly in search of the “promised land”? Even as a conductor at the top of society, was life within the train never enough for her?[/p][p][/p][h1]Landmarks[/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/fb6144a6f344a8df2f375a05ca97dab3adb19d73.png"][/img][/p][p]Do you remember [b]Landmarks[/b]?[/p][p]As you wander across the frozen world, you’ll occasionally encounter strange and unique places.[/p][p]Some of these may hide powerful artifacts; others may present pivotal events that force you to make difficult choices. You’ll constantly weigh whether an immediate, guaranteed reward is worth giving up the potential for greater long-term gains — or, conversely, whether risking expulsion for a brighter future is worth it.[/p][p][/p][h1]Decisions[/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/dd28acad2677131eece2fe5bfcf52772337eeed6.png"][/img][/p][p]Kings, emperors, conductors… what do they all share? They are the ones who [b]make decisions[/b].[/p][p]To rule a society is to set its direction. Each decision sends ripples through the train: some may be minor, granting a few resources, while others are monumental, unlocking effects that combine with artifacts for immense power.[/p][p]But you cannot unlock everything at once. Decisions unfold step by step, with prerequisites gating what comes next. This means careful planning and foresight are required — every path you choose matters.[/p][p]So, will you lead like Choi Soon-ja, with logic and methodical planning? Or will you command like Im Seok-dae, ruling with charisma and iron discipline? The choice is yours.[/p][p][/p][h1]Children of the Engine[/h1][hr][/hr][p]The [b]Children of the Engine[/b] are the only established order of faith within train society. Perhaps, in hidden corners, others still worship unseen gods — but inside the train, the Engine’s influence is absolute.[/p][p]The Engine is eternal, and the train must run. Under this creed, they worship the everlasting train and its unfailing Engine. And as with all religions, one rule always applies: [b]prayer must be done well.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/645c909942dd6d9de71b4be87668ed7d6a361c06.gif"][/img][/p][p]When you align with the Children of the Engine synergy, you’ll offer prayers each cycle to build up [b]Faith[/b]. Once that Faith surpasses a certain threshold, the god of the Engine may look kindly upon you and bestow a [b]gift[/b].[/p][p]If pleased, the Engine may bless you with rare rewards. But when the deity is busy or indifferent… well, sometimes the gift may be nothing special at all.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/b25d445bf0068eb1f7fd6aa0877aeef63c9ba4a8.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Engine God is almighty. At times, He may grant you a rare train without asking anything in return… or a powerful artifact. But He is also capricious. To Him, perhaps all train cars look the same. Surely you wouldn’t complain, would you?[/p][p]Careful — the Engine God may grow angry! (And send you an even worse “gift”! 😂)[/p][p][/p][h1]New Artifacts![/h1][hr][/hr][p]First, let’s revisit the silhouette we teased last time:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/e965f48eb358853381664914e02a7a3379dae5da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And the answer is…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/4fa8fe50ee7dfb0e4af97435338607fc8fe0e5e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A cute little teddy bear! …Though it’s a pity he’s shackled by the ankle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/6e7915b6ff09c292b42c4c3cf2db2ee38b9e5217.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yes — in desperate times, some choices may become inevitable…[/p][p][/p][h1]In Closing[/h1][hr][/hr][p]That’s all we’ve prepared for today. It won’t be long now before we can finally share the game with you. We’ll give it our very best until the end to deliver a fun and memorable experience. Thank you![/p][p]Until next time, stay warm and keep your train running.[/p][p][/p][p]With gratitude,[/p][p]nemonan[/p]

notes.title: Frostrain2 Store Page is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello to all conductors around the world who have shown love for Frostrain!
It may be a little early for a full developer letter, but we’re reaching out today for another exciting reason: our store page is now open![/p][p]Visit the store page to check out details about the sequel, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690490/Frostrain2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Development is still ongoing, and we plan to update the store page along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]How does the game look to you?[/p][p]If there’s anything you’d like to see, improve, or suggest, drop a comment or send us an email at [url="https://nemonan.inc@gmail.com"]nemonan.inc@gmail.com[/url]. We’re checking out everything you send![/p][p]Now, it’s back to work for us—we’ll be doing our best to bring you the Early Access version this October. Thank you so much for your support![/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, nemonan.[/p][p][/p][p]X(Twitter) : [url="https://x.com/frostraingame"]https://x.com/frostraingame[/url][/p]

notes.title: July Developer Letter
notes.notes: [p]Hello to all the conductors around the world who love [i]Frostrain[/i]![/p][p]It's that time again—how have you been? We've been steadily improving the game based on all the feedback you’ve sent us, and today, we’d love to share some of those changes with you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Feedback Is Always Welcome![/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Yaslana[/b] (and many others) gave us this feedback:[/p][quote][p]“The objects in the foreground feel visually distracting.”[/p][/quote][p]And you know what? We agree.[/p][p]We originally added those foreground elements to enhance the sense of speed and immersion, but if they’re disrupting gameplay, then they’re not doing their job. We’ve tried adjusting the spacing, reducing their number, and even removing some entirely—but nothing felt quite right yet. Your feedback means a lot, and we’ll keep exploring new ways to create immersive environments without compromising gameplay clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TWIGI[/b] suggested:[/p][quote][p]“How about making the train itself bigger?”[/p][/quote][p]Absolutely! A tiny train just doesn’t feel right—especially when it's humanity’s last hope. But at the same time, we want players to manage their entire fleet at a glance—ideally at least 8 cars! There’s just something satisfying about laying out and managing all your trains in a row. So we’ve decided to scale up the trains while still keeping them compact enough to stay visually manageable.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a glimpse at some of the improvements we’ve made based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/8f03ddf2a6cca01d1309338676ee7ae79f30a9e3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And of course—this isn’t final. We’re constantly iterating and polishing, so stay tuned!(Can you feel the difference in speed and clarity?)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/4d077d9c45961daf77af69305950357a05096e1a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Uh-oh! Looks like the train just entered a blizzard.[/p][p]The world outside is already unforgiving—but the blizzard is even worse. Visibility drops to nearly zero, and bone-chilling cold sweeps through the cars. Be careful—brief exposure might be manageable, but linger too long and your passengers might just revolt…[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Upgrading Is Always Fun![/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/83f2c85a7608ebb097583863097e1917dc1dee80.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There’s just something deeply satisfying about upgrading—especially when you can really [i]feel[/i] the improvement. That’s why we’ve worked hard to make the effects look and sound more [i]delicious[/i]. What do you think? Does it feel more impactful now? Watching the train level up layer by layer even puts a smile on our faces.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]More Drones, More Trains![/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/e20a9c27fc82927ea4c8518aa14be030c5f94a5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Getting rewards is always exciting—there’s a thrill in not knowing what you'll get, and a real rush when it’s exactly what you wanted. How many drone drops do you want this time? In this installment, you'll be able to combine artifacts and create builds that allow [i]tons[/i] of drone supply choices. The more, the merrier—like opening a pile of Christmas presents![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]New Artifact Spotlight[/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/fb3d3870432b91448f1c9aba20aac4fa61da84d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A blazing dashboard—what kind of effect could it have?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/6cc1d546444c55bd42b381a2af7e7008dc887b2a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This artifact rewards you with happiness the faster your train moves. Remember the raw power of energy in the original [i]Frostrain[/i]? While energy might not be quite as dominant in the sequel, with this artifact in hand, you can still build around speed-based synergies—and it’s as fun as ever.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]What Was That Artifact?[/h1][hr][/hr][p]Remember the mysterious artifact silhouette we showed last time? Did you make a guess?[/p][p][/p][p][b]hjgd157[/b] suggested it looked like a "train coupler."[/p][p]Unfortunately we don't have a visual mock-up for that one, but it’s an interesting idea![/p][p][/p][p]Then came [b]ZM[/b], who sent us this delightful submission:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/e6d6baa0d0bbcb4e8b1ee12869a5cf469579fee6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now [i]that’s[/i] some dedication—we love it. Also... we [i]do[/i] like hamburgers. Guess we know what we’re having for dinner tonight.[/p][p][/p][p]The correct answer is revealed![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/80ad1d61979afda710fece42d6378383bb852560.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The answer was [b]chips and cards[/b]! These come with the following effect:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/08d584c546788079d1986b9412506c529665317e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The artifact [b]“Gambler”[/b] grants a large amount of experience all at once, but after that, you won’t be able to gain any more experience. It’s a tempting choice when the game is nearing its end, or when the tide is turning and you need to find a strong train quickly. In those moments, using it strategically could be a game-changer—a true gamble.[/p][p]But be careful! A bold move can bring massive rewards, but it can also backfire.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]And Now, a New Silhouette![/h1][hr][/hr][p]This one seems a little easier to guess…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/e965f48eb358853381664914e02a7a3379dae5da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Did something immediately come to mind? If you have a guess, feel free to email us at [url="https://nemonan.inc@gmail.com"]nemonan.inc@gmail.com[/url]. And yes—we read [b]every single comment and message[/b] you send. Whether it’s feedback, a theory, or a silly guess, we’re always happy to hear from you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]In Closing[/h1][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for today’s update. We’re currently aiming to release a demo for [i]Frostrain 2[/i] during the [b]October Next Fest[/b]. We’re giving it everything we’ve got—thank you for staying with us on this journey![/p][p]Stay warm, and keep those trains running. Until next time![/p]

notes.title: June Developer Letter
notes.notes: [p]Hello, conductors from all around the world who’ve been enjoying Frostrain![/p][p]It’s been a while—half a year, in fact—since we rolled out the last “Sparkle Update.” How have you been?[/p][p]Thanks to your unwavering support, we’ve been hard at work on the sequel. Every single comment you’ve left has been a huge source of motivation for us. (Not just saying that—we actually read every one of them, truly!)[/p][p][/p][h1]New Language Support[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Turkish added[/p][/*][/list][p]First things first—new language support![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Turkish[/b] has been added to Frostrain. A heartfelt thank-you to the users who contributed to the translation. Because of your help, even more players around the world can now enjoy the game.[/p][p]We've always dreamed of the day when people from different countries and languages could connect through one common theme: games. Thanks to you, Frostrain is now available in [b]16 languages[/b]! That’s entirely thanks to our incredible community.[/p][p][/p][h1]About the Sequel[/h1][p][/p][p]Now, let’s talk about the sequel’s development.[/p][p]We’ve chosen to approach the sequel with care and precision.[/p][p]Rather than completely reinventing the wheel, we’re treating Frostrain 2 as an extension of the first game. We're adding lots of new content, but staying true to the original tone and direction.[/p][p]We’ve seen many sequels lose their way by changing too much— and we’ve learned from those examples. That said, we’re also determined to [b]boldly improve and fix the parts[/b] we weren’t satisfied with in the first game.[/p][p]Oh—and before we dive into the details, we should mention: Our art style has evolved a bit. We hope you’ll like the direction we're heading in![/p][p]Everything you see below is still [b]in[/b] development, and may change before release.[/p][p]Your feedback is always welcome![/p][p][/p][h2]A More Intense Conductor[/h2][p]Meet Mr. [b]Lim[/b], our no-nonsense conductor![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/929e5da6d2fb776107989dc4c11f6d9d2c623a93.png"][/img][/p][p]He looks like he could reach out and grab you by the collar any second.[/p][p]Stubborn, paranoid, and authoritarian—Mr. Lim will be by your side once again.[/p][p]But how did he seize control of the train—and come to rule it with an iron will?[/p][p][/p][h2]Environments to Draw You In[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/73715a4d5b7c0ff58d1b28829bd70099fa128018.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The train races through the heart of the forest![/p][p]We’re working hard to bring [b]a[/b] richer, more diverse world to life in the sequel. Blizzards and snowstorms still cover the land, but the world hasn’t completely crumbled—yet.[/p][p]We’re not sure whether those countless trees are alive, but they still stand.[/p][p](And yes, the trees are huge. Let’s just call it a bit of game magic!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/af4da02fba09f193eb7730598de308c1a996a548.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a vast open plain![/p][p]The storm makes it hard to see ahead, but if you squint past the horizon, you might catch the sight of giant clouds gliding nobly across the sky. Something about that open view clears the mind, doesn't it?[/p][p]Maybe if you keep riding this train... you’ll arrive at the [i]Abandoned City[/i] at last.[/p][p][/p][h2]Powerful Artifacts and Difficult Choices[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/34d404037d127960701a0c1e1846dab7d5e3ec3c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A bloodstained dagger. It reeks of iron and violence... What kind of power could it hold?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/b86af934c37c44ea22ef61becf2a9993714e9a1b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s right—in the sequel, you’ll sometimes be able to execute passengers. Not always—only under certain events, or when you’ve acquired specific artifacts.[/p][p]This one, called [b]Sadism[/b], will open a new path for you.[/p][p]Sure, more passengers usually means more options... But with mutiny just around the corner, how many times have you [i]wished[/i] you could just throw someone off the train?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791759/2dfaf2aa590d5df9d2dd9f46167f0635478e529c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Until our next update, we wanted to leave you with something to ponder: What might this artifact actually do?[/p][p]Got a fun or twisted idea? Send it to [url="https://nemonan.inc@gmail.com"]nemonan.inc@gmail.com[/url]![/p][p]If it's really clever, we’d love to share it—or, If you’re okay with it, we’d love to use it in the game—with your full permission, naturally. And if not, that’s totally fine too![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]In Closing[/h1][p][/p][p]That’s all the news we have for today. We’re pouring our energy into the sequel and racing [b]full steam[/b] ahead. We hope to reconnect with you again through this game.[/p][p]Got feedback, thoughts, or ideas? Feel free to email us anytime at [url="https://nemonan.inc@gmail.com"]nemonan.inc@gmail.com[/url]. We’re always listening.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]Best regards, nemonan.[/p]

notes.title: Sparkling Gifts Are Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello, conductors around the world! We're back today with some good news, some bad news, and... a little update!

[h1]Good news and bad news[/h1]

Which would you rather hear first? Personally, I prefer to hear the bad news first—let’s save the good news as a treat to lift the mood after.

So... let's start with the bad news. We’re sorry to say that despite announcing the development of *FrostTrain 2* back in June, it has been half a year… and we haven’t made any visible progress yet. Please believe me when I say this: balancing a day job with game development is extremely tough. To those superhumans who manage to do both—you have our utmost admiration.

But it’s too early to feel discouraged! Here's the good news: we’ve decided to go **full-time development**! 

As I told you, we realized balancing work and game development was a tough challenge, so we made a bold decision: **we're going all in.** We've left our day jobs (or school life) behind and are now fully committed to development. From this point forward, we're putting all our time and resources to making this game the best it can be!

The past half-year hasn’t gone to waste, though. We’ve spent the time meticulously planning and refining the game’s structure. Now, it’s all about building and polishing. We’re aiming for a release in the second half of next year, and we’ll keep you updated on our progress. Your support is our heartbeat—without it, we wouldn’t be here.

[h1]Sparkles are coming![/h1]

[h2]Add sparkles[/h2]

Now, onto something shiny (literally!). Just announcing our plans might feel a little incomplete, so we’ve prepared a small update to share with you. Many of you mentioned that the maps feel static and repetitive, leading to a “best path” problem. To combat this, we’ve introduced a new feature: **sparkles**. When you visit a sparkle on the map, you'll get an extra drone supply as a reward. This simple tweak will hopefully encourage you to explore alternative routes and break the monotony.

[h2]Passengers are getting impatient[/h2]

Passengers will now require 5% more happiness per day.

The aforementioned updates have made the game a little easier, which is not necessarily a bad thing, but sometimes it's necessary to make things a little more straightforward. Passengers will be a little more 'impatient' from now on.

[h1]Localization[/h1]

New language added: **Italian**! 🇮🇹

Frostrain is being translated with the help of our amazing players. Thank you so much to everyone who contributed to this translation effort. Press credits button to pay respects to the translators!

Thank you for sticking with us and reading this update. I’ll see you next time with more development updates! Until then, keep conducting!

Merry christmas!

Sincerely, STEWDIO

notes.title: Developer Letter, and the 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Frostrain loving conductors around the world! It's been a while, how have you been? It's been almost two months since we announced that we were launching a new update, and a lot has happened. Today we'd like to talk about.

[h1]New languages added[/h1]

We've added new languages! Here are the new languages we've added

- German
- Chinese (Simplified)
- Chinese (Traditional)
- French
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Ukrainian
- Hungarian
- Japanese

We apologize for the long wait and the late update. We had a lot of help from a lot of people, and thanks to them, we were able to make the update happen. Now you can start your journey to the promised land without language barriers!

[h1]Usability improvements[/h1]

We've improved something that many of you have been complaining about.

- You can now skip the "Department of Press" rant at the start of the game. That was a lot of words, we apologize.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

We've also fixed some other minor bugs.

[h1]What's next[/h1]

A lot has happened in the last two months. We tried to add a lot of features, and we even tried to introduce a new system, but the internal structure was much more complicated than we thought it would be, and unfortunately it didn't turn out to be successful.

However, we were too disappointed to give up on the project, so after a series of internal team meetings, we came to one conclusion: let's make a new one.

That's right, we're planning a sequel. We hope to bring you Frostrain 2 with all the exciting elements we originally wanted to include.

Unfortunately, as we've been saying all along, we all have day jobs, so it's going to be a very long development period, but we're going to keep working on it once a week and slowly but surely bring it to you.

We don't know how long this will take, because as you know, there are a lot of variables that come into play during a long development period. It could take two or three years, it could take ten years, or it could even stop halfway through. But we'll work as diligently as we can, because we're as passionate about the game as you are.

Thank you for reading this long post.

STEWDIO Reparations.

notes.title: Restart the update!
notes.notes:
Hello, all you conductors in Frostrain around the world! It's been a while, and we hope you've been doing well. Our development team has been busy with a number of issues. As we mentioned in our last developer letter, some of us have taken on jobs to make ends meet, some have gone back to school to study, and... well... we decided that we couldn't turn a blind eye to the support you've been giving us.

However, we realize that we can't afford to release updates as quickly or as big as we'd like to, so we'll be releasing small comfort updates, balance updates more frequently than in the past, and taking a little longer to release updates with new content whenever possible.

So many of you have been so kind to us, and while we politely declined at first, we felt it would be rude to turn you down any further, so we thought we'd show our appreciation in a small way.

This update includes two announcements and a small balance patch. Thanks!


[h1]Major localization announcements.[/h1]

We've had conductors from Korea, the US, Germany, China, the Czech Republic... and so many other countries enjoy our game, but they've been frustrated by the fact that we only support two languages. We know the difference between a game that supports your native language and one that doesn't - there's a lot of experience lost in the process of "seeing" and "translating".

We released the game on a deadline, so our internal structure wasn't ideal for localization, and that's still the case today, so we're planning to refactor and overhaul the structure so that more people can enjoy the game.

As you know, we're a free-to-play game, so it's hard for us to offer any compensation to those who helped with the translation, but it's almost like you're building the game alongside us, and we'd like to add your name to the credits as a small token of our appreciation for your efforts.

We could use a lot of help. If you're interested, please contact us at the following emails.

devhanghae@gmail.com


[h1]Memory issues are not crypto mining[/h1]

A lot of people have accused our game of being a crypto-mining game. First of all, let me say that Frostrain is not crypto-mined, and that... I... I hate to say this, but it's a problem that was caused by our own lack of competence.

We are aware of the memory issue. My best guess is that it's caused by blizzard effects or exploration nodes. We'll give you the option to turn blizzard effects off and on as a first step, and if you're still experiencing issues... this could be a big systemic fix.

But just to be clear, we're NEVER mining cryptocurrency! Rest assured, you're on your way to the promised land!


[h1]Balance adjustment[/h1]

Since launch, we've held off on balance patches as much as possible. We were worried about drastically changing your experience, but we feel like enough people have enjoyed the game that it's worth tweaking it a bit. We're also worried that we've lost our touch with Frostrain since it's been a while, but we're going to keep a close eye on it and tweak the balance little by little. It's a data-heavy process, and we need your help!

The goal of this balance patch is to make each synergy work more "as intended". To be clear, we're not trying to achieve equal balance - some synergies will be more favorable than others - but they will have different "balance factors": less fun, harder to build combinations, etc.

[h2]Fuel and Hammer Brotherhood[/h2]

The Brotherhood have been a little too... quiet. They've been ridiculously underpowered for a tail section organization, and their base happiness output is so low that even if you have 7 synergy to blow up 10x, it's often not enough. This patch aims to revamp the high-risk-low-reward structure of these brotherhood to make them the high-risk-high-reward they were meant to be.

In addition, we want to make sure that other synergies that are woven into them are indirectly rewarded. For example, entertainment, education, etc.

[h3]Job School[/h3]

Level 1 : Happiness +1. Add +1 if passenger is full. → Happiness +2. Add +1 if passenger is full.

Level 2 : Happiness +2. Add +3 if passenger is full. → Happiness +3. Add +3 if passenger is full.

Level 3 : Happiness +3. Add +4 if passenger is full. → Happiness +5. Add +6 if passenger is full.

Level 4 : Happiness +4. Add +6 if passenger is full. → Happiness +7. Add +10 if passenger is full.

[h3]Private Gambling House[/h3]

Level 1 : Happiness +0~+3 → Happiness +1~+3

Level 2 : Happiness +1~+4 → Happiness +2~+5

Level 3 : Happiness+2~+6 → Happiness+3~+8

Level 4 : Happiness+3~+8 → Happiness+6~+14

[h3]Sheriff's Office[/h3]

Level 1 : Happiness+3 → Happiness+4

Level 2 : Happiness+4 → Happiness+6

Level 3 : Happiness+6 → Happiness+9

Level 4 : Happiness+12 → Happiness+18

[h3]Communication Center[/h3]

Level 1 : Happiness+2 → Happiness+3

Level 2 : Happiness+3 → Happiness+4

Level 3 : Happiness+4 → Happiness+6

Level 4 : Happiness+8 → Happiness+12

[h2]Guild of Explorers[/h2]

Guild of Explorers is a useful synergy to have early on, but I wouldn't call it powerful. We've made its reward more powerful, making it more pleasing to use.

- It now produces more happiness as a reward!

[h2]Communication[/h2]

Communication is an easy synergy to achieve with only 2 car spaces, so we were worried that it might be forced, but since not many people seem to be looking for it, we thought we'd give it a little more... even if it's just a little.

Before : (+4 per train car)

After : (+5 per train car)

[h2]Train Power[/h2]

Train Power has always been the "heart of the train" - it's an essential part of the train, but it's been overpowered, so let's break it down a bit.

Train Power(3) : Improves 300% faster. → 240% faster improvement.

[h2]Security[/h2]

Security was a synergy that really went through the motions. Looking at its abilities alone, it's definitely a backbone synergy that's responsible for the early to mid game, but it's also a tier 4 facility, so it's not easy to get it right. We have a lot of thoughts on how to improve it (within the limits of what we can do), but first, we're going to make it worthy of tier 4 so that it can be used in the late game.

Security(4) : Gain Central Intelligence Agency (+50 Happiness) → Gain Central Intelligence Agency (+72 Happiness).

notes.title: Developer letter
notes.notes:
Hello, Frostrain-playing conductors around the world! We are writing to you today with a few fixes and a developer letter.

[h1]“Play the demo”[/h1]

As a team of five beginners in the game development industry, we would like to explain our situation before proceeding any further. This is our first game release and some of us are still in school. The whole reason we got together to make the game in the first place was to be judged on our abilities by our users, not on the basis of "let's make a lot of money off of this!".

This is why we planned to release the game for free from the beginning and why it was developed in a short timeframe of two months. As a result, several parts of the game were left unfinished, as some players may have noticed.

The 'demo play' reference also goes hand in hand with this. We believed that the game was incomplete at launch and our objective was to release a demo-sized game as quickly as possible for evaluation. However, we didn't realise that this would cause embarrassment and offence to many players.

In conclusion, this is currently the full version of the game. Once again, we apologize for any confusion we may have caused.

[h1]System Requirements[/h1]

We have received feedback that the recommended system requirements for the game on the Steam page are strange. 4060 for a 2D game? As a gamer, this is completely unacceptable. Geez.... A game that could run on a Samsung refrigerator! Unfortunately, we were unable to accurately measure the game's specifications with our current environment. If you have any suggestions or relevant information that could assist us, please inform us.

[h1]Game volume & Localization[/h1]

Several players have commented on the small size of the maps. The game was intended to be much larger, with an endless mode featuring procedural map generation and a separate scenario mode with pre-generated maps. 

We appreciate that players from different countries, such as Germany, the Czech Republic, China, and Russia, enjoy our games. We are grateful to our international users. Therefore, we understand the significance of offering a localized experience for our players. 

Unfortunately, due to the limited two-month development timeframe, we were unable to provide the desired level of experience.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Satoru Iwata once said, “In my mind, I am a game developer. But in my heart, I am a gamer." As much as we'd like to make the game more enjoyable for more people, we are unable to provide the 'big update' at this time due to practical reasons.

But our hearts remain as gamers. We can't turn our backs on the thousands of players who love our game, and we will continue to provide support through small updates, primarily focused on improving usability and fixing bugs.

Thank you for reading this long post, and thank you again for playing and loving our game.

Sincerely, STEWDIO Devs.

notes.title: New conductors are on board!
notes.notes:
Hello players! We released the game to you on the 11th, and we've been blown away by your outpouring of support over the past five days. This patch is our little thank you gift to you. We've fixed bugs, brought in some new conductors, and made a few convenience improvements!

[h1]New Conductor![/h1]

The new conductors are on board! They have swayed public opinion on the train with their own merits.

[h2]Choi Soon-Ja[/h2]

Choi Soon-Ja took control of the train step by step with her surveillance and hard-nosedness.

She has two more train cars than you do, but gets to choose two cards from the drone supply.

[h2]Joe mimi[/h2]

Joe mimi has taken the train by storm, gaining the trust of many, but some passengers are still suspicious of her.

She has 4 cards as options in the drone supply, but needs more happiness.

These are gradually unlocked as you play. Enjoy more colorful play!



[h1]Balance Patch[/h1]

[h2]Storms[/h2]

- Storms now follow a little faster.

[h2]Synergy[/h2]

- Train Power Adjustments
    
    Academy members have been dominating the power source! We're making some adjustments.
    
    - Train Design Room improvements reduced
        - Level 1 5 →3
        - Level 2 10 → 6
        - Level 3 20 → 12
        - Level 4 60 → 36
        - Level 5 100 → 54
    - Increased Synergy Gain Multiplier
        - 3Synergy 200% → 300
        - 5Synergy 500% → 600
- Press Adjustments
    
    We've improved the behavior of Press synergies, which was counterintuitive.
    
    - When you arrive in a new region (node), you gain happiness based on the number of [b]Press[/b] facilities you have → When you arrive in a new region (node), you gain happiness based on the number of [b]Train[/b] facilities you have.
    - (2): +10 → +2
    - (3): +80 → +16
    - (4): +320 → +128

[h2]Trains[/h2]

- Reduced experience requirements in higher level sections.
    - Level 7 10 → 9
    - Level 8 12 → 10
    - Level 9 16 → 12



[h1]etc.[/h1]

[h2]UI[/h2]

- Added resolution
- Support for windowed mode
- Changed settings UI
- Fix tutorial UI

[h2]Usability[/h2]

- Improved the initial language setting to be more natural based on your computer's settings.
- Frustrated by not being able to click on the task bubble? It's now fixed so that you can click on the bubble. (Originally you had to click on the train car, sorry!)
- We now support Steam Cloud! Enjoy your unlocked elements wherever you are! (We did our best, but there may be errors due to technical limitations...)

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

- Fixed control center location error
- Fixed an error where happiness was not printed correctly when it was over 1 million
